name: Hookle
description_en:
Hookle is a mobile-first social publishing assistant for small business owners. It brings connected social accounts, drafts, scheduling, AI-assisted content and simplified performance views into one app. Its supported account types matter: a Facebook Page, Pinterest board and LinkedIn profile are separate connections, rather than one allowance for each network.

A practical evaluation follows one business update from an AI idea or original draft through account-specific customization, scheduling and a check of the actual published result. Businesses provide separate working spaces within one Hookle account, while current commercial terms distinguish Free, Solo and Plus. Older guides still use Premium or Multi terminology, so this profile records the documented transitions rather than treating those names as separate current products or assuming every old allowance applies today.
description_zh:
Hookle 是面向小企业主的移动优先社交发布助手，把已连接账户、草稿、排程、AI 辅助内容及简化效果视图集中到一个应用。支持的账户类型很重要：Facebook Page、Pinterest Board、LinkedIn Profile 分别消耗连接数，不能理解为每个网络只算一个。

实用评估可跟踪一条业务更新，从 AI 想法或原创草稿经过账户定制、排程，再检查真实发布结果。Businesses 在同一 Hookle 账户提供独立工作空间，当前商业组合区分 Free、Solo、Plus。旧指南仍使用 Premium 或 Multi，本文记录已确认的名称变化，不把它们当作当前独立产品，也不假定全部旧额度今天适用。

core_features.explanation_en: Separate social accounts, drafts, stats and AI settings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 分开社交账户、草稿、指标及 AI 设置。

core_features.explanation_en: Review and adjust a recommended date/time before confirming.
core_features.explanation_zh: 确认前审阅及调整推荐日期时间。

core_features.explanation_en: Open a business-tailored idea and edit, draft or schedule it.
core_features.explanation_zh: 打开业务专属想法，编辑、存草稿或排程。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure weekly/monthly repetition within documented limits.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在文档限制内配置每周／每月重复。

en: Prepare and schedule an owner-operated shop’s weekly updates.
Keep several businesses separate while sharing a connection allowance.
Evaluate AI-assisted drafting with explicit publication and metric checks.
zh: 准备业主运营商店的每周更新及排程。
在共享连接额度下分开多个业务。
以明确发布及指标检查评估 AI 辅助写作。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Customize account content and confirm the intended scheduling time.
steps.zh: 定制账户内容，确认预期排程时间。

steps.en: Inspect native results before retrying a failure.
steps.zh: 重试失败前检查原生结果。

steps.en: Compare matching periods and account sets in Stats.
steps.zh: 在 Stats 比较一致周期及账户集合。

items.zh: 账户有计划帖子时阻止移动 Business。

A Failed label can coexist with actual Facebook publication.

supported_languages.scope: App screens, menus and notifications; post and AI-input languages are separate.

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current family: Free, Solo and Plus. July 2026 documentation says Solo replaces Premium; Multi added up to five brands/30 accounts and does not come with legacy plans. August update renames Multi to Plus; current Business help confirms the shared 30-account pool. Free supports three connected accounts and one Business; Solo one Business. Exact current amounts, currency, billing periods, paid feature limits and trial/renewal terms were not verified: web pricing repeatedly timed out, and ordinary TLS-verified HTTPS returned only a marketing shell. No historical amount adopted.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前系列为 Free、Solo、Plus。2026 年 7 月文档说 Solo 替代 Premium，新增 Multi 最多五品牌／30 账户，不随旧计划包含。8 月更新将 Multi 更名 Plus，当前 Business 帮助确认共享 30 账户池。Free 支持三个连接账户、一个 Business，Solo 一个 Business。未核实当前金额、币种、周期、付费能力限制及试用／续费条款：网页读取反复超时，普通验证 TLS 的 HTTPS 仅取得营销外壳。不采用历史金额。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Connect the actual eligible account, not just a platform name
sections.title_zh: 连接真实合格账户，不只看平台名称
sections.en: The current support list covers Instagram professional accounts, Facebook Pages, LinkedIn pages/profiles, TikTok, X, Threads, YouTube, Bluesky, verified Google Business Profiles and Pinterest boards. Personal Facebook/Instagram, Facebook/LinkedIn groups and Pinterest personal accounts are excluded. X publishing requires Plus. Editorial setup: list each intended destination and native administrator before connecting; a paid plan does not change an unsupported account type into a supported one. Exact per-format eligibility still needs confirmation in the app.
sections.zh: 当前支持清单包含 Instagram 专业账户、Facebook Page、LinkedIn Page／Profile、TikTok、X、Threads、YouTube、Bluesky、已验证 Google Business Profile 及 Pinterest Board。排除个人 Facebook／Instagram、Facebook／LinkedIn Group、Pinterest 个人账户，X 发布需 Plus。编辑设置建议：连接前列出真实目的地及原生管理员；付费不能把不支持账户类型变为支持。每种内容格式仍需在应用确认。

sections.title_en: Moving an account requires an empty scheduled queue
sections.title_zh: 移动账户需先清空计划队列
sections.en: Each Business has separate posts, AI settings and insights; one social account belongs to one Business. Moving it transfers history and stats without reconnecting, but queued posts remain tied to the original Business, so the move is blocked until those posts are published or deleted. The connection allowance is shared across Businesses. Downgrading locks excess Businesses while retaining data; deleting a Business permanently removes its posts/stats and disconnects accounts. Editorial multi-shop workflow: verify the active Business before composing and resolve the existing queue before reorganizing accounts.
sections.zh: 每个 Business 独立保存帖子、AI 设置及指标，一个社交账户只属一个 Business。移动无需重连，会迁移历史及指标，但计划帖绑定原业务，因此须先发布或删除才可移动。连接额度在所有 Business 间共享。降级锁定超额 Business 并保留数据，删除 Business 永久移除帖子／指标并断开账户。编辑多店流程建议：写作前检查当前 Business，重组账户前处理原队列。

sections.title_en: Daily inspiration is a draftable suggestion, not verified business copy
sections.title_zh: 每日灵感是可编辑建议，不是已核实业务文案
sections.en: AIDE uses business description and language preferences to propose a new post each day. It can be edited, saved as draft, scheduled or published. Free users have five inspirations total, counted only on the first opening for that day; the documented paid feature continues afterward. Missing or unsuitable business description can prevent suggestions. Editorial local-service example: review actual opening hours, availability and claim wording before using a generated offer. Neither an AI image nor matching tone establishes that the described service is currently available.
sections.zh: AIDE 根据业务描述及语言偏好每日提出新帖，可编辑、存草稿、排程或发布。免费用户共五次灵感，每天首次打开才计数，之后使用文档中的付费能力。缺失或不合适业务描述可能不生成建议。编辑本地服务示例：使用优惠文案前检查真实营业时间、供应情况及主张。AI 图片或语气匹配不能证明所描述服务当前可用。

sections.title_en: Review AI timing before relying on it
sections.title_zh: 依赖 AI 时间前先审阅
sections.en: Normal scheduling supports dates up to two years ahead; recurring content has a six-month horizon. Smart Scheduling proposes a day and time from content and engagement trends, but the guide labels it Beta and allows manual correction. Beginning from a calendar day constrains the recommendation to that day. Editorial event announcement: compare the proposed time with the actual event and audience timezone, then inspect the scheduled card. A vendor claim of “optimal” does not independently establish improved reach, and recommendation latency is not a publication SLA.
sections.zh: 普通排程最远两年，重复内容最远六个月。Smart Scheduling 根据内容及互动趋势提出日期时间，但指南标为 Beta，可人工更正。从日历某日开始会把推荐限制在该日。编辑活动公告建议：把推荐与真实活动及受众时区比较，再检查计划卡片。供应商“最佳”主张不独立证明触达提升，推荐生成延迟也不是发布 SLA。

sections.title_zh: 重复内容有平台排除范围
sections.en: The recurring guide supports weekly/monthly conditions, selected days/times and duration, with up to 50 recurring posts and a six-month scheduling period. It excludes recurring publishing to X and Pinterest. Editing is available through the recurring item’s details. Editorial weekly menu example: use distinct day-specific content and an end date, then verify a changed price before extending the sequence. Repetition is not permission to ignore native platform restrictions; exact handling of an occurrence already in flight was not verified.
sections.zh: 重复指南支持每周／每月条件、指定日期时间及持续时长，最多 50 条重复帖子、计划期六个月。排除向 X、Pinterest 重复发布，可在详情修改。编辑每周菜单示例：按日使用不同内容及结束日期，延长前检查价格变化。重复能力不能取消原生平台限制，未核实已执行中某次发送的修改处理。

sections.title_en: Check the native post before retrying a Failed result
sections.title_zh: 重试 Failed 前先检查原生帖子
sections.en: Facebook troubleshooting explicitly describes cases where publication succeeded but Hookle reports failure. Check the native destination first. Other documented causes include expired authorization, insufficient permissions or unsuitable content; reconnecting and a deliberate Retry may be needed. Published Facebook content must be deleted natively under the documented limitation. Editorial recovery: record which account actually received the update, fix the named error and resend only when necessary. No universal deduplication, automatic replay or atomic all-account success guarantee was verified.
sections.zh: Facebook 故障指南明确描述实际成功但 Hookle 显示失败的情况，应先检查原生目的地。其他原因包括授权过期、权限不足及内容不适合，可能需重连及有意 Retry。按文档限制，已发布 Facebook 内容需原生删除。编辑恢复建议：记录哪个账户实际收到更新，修复所示错误，仅在需要时重发。未核实通用去重、自动重放或跨账户原子成功保证。

sections.title_en: Separate a missing metric from weak performance
sections.title_zh: 区分缺失指标与表现弱
sections.en: Stats compare the last 30 days with the previous 30. Native posts may be included, but X/LinkedIn profile post counts use Hookle-created content. Reach/reactions are unavailable for several account types; TikTok and Stories have further gaps. The separate Social Score is a vendor-defined 0–100 composite affected by connecting/disconnecting accounts and data availability. Editorial review: keep the account set and metric scope stable before comparing periods. A score change is not a measured change in sales, and summing platform reach does not establish a deduplicated audience.
sections.zh: Stats 比较最近 30 天与此前 30 天，可能包含原生帖子，但 X／LinkedIn Profile 帖数使用 Hookle 创建内容。部分账户类型没有触达／反应，TikTok、Stories 另有缺口。独立 Social Score 是供应商定义的 0–100 综合值，受连接／断开及数据可用性影响。编辑复盘建议：跨期比较前固定账户集合与指标范围。分数变化不是销售变化测量，平台触达相加也不证明去重受众。

sections.title_en: Multiple-business organization does not prove role-based approvals
sections.title_zh: 多业务组织不证明分角色审批
sections.en: The older teamwork article describes separate Hookle logins connected to the same firm’s channels or a shared Hookle account, rather than distinct user seats. Current Businesses describe account organization, not a documented editor/reviewer permission hierarchy. Editorial fit: an owner preparing their own weekly updates has a different requirement from an agency needing client sign-off, named audit trails or restricted publishing. Verify those controls directly before choosing Hookle for that latter workflow; no native approval-chain guarantee was established.
sections.zh: 较旧团队文章描述各自 Hookle 登录连接同一企业渠道，或共享一个 Hookle 账户，而不是独立用户席位。当前 Businesses 描述账户组织，未给出编辑／审阅权限层级。编辑适配判断：业主自己准备每周更新，与需要客户签核、实名审计、限制发布的代理机构需求不同。后者选择前应直接确认控制，未建立原生审批链保证。

sections.title_en: UI language follows the phone, while post language is independent
sections.title_zh: 界面跟随手机语言，帖子语言独立
sections.en: The official language guide lists 12 UI languages, including Chinese, and says unsupported device languages fall back to English. Menus and notifications follow the device, while posts can use any language and AI suggestions can use the language of the input. The vendor identifies UI translations as AI-generated. Editorial localization check: inspect important account and scheduling labels in the device language, then separately review the generated post’s facts and tone. Chinese UI availability does not establish regional account access or native-platform availability.
sections.zh: 官方语言指南列出含中文的 12 种界面语言，不支持的设备语言回退英语。菜单、通知跟随设备，帖子可用任意语言，AI 可按输入语言建议。供应商说明界面翻译由 AI 生成。编辑本地化建议：按设备语言检查重要账户及排程标签，再另审生成内容事实与语气。中文界面可用不证明地区账户访问或原生平台可用。

seo.description_zh: 核对 Hookle Businesses、Free／Solo／Plus 变化、重复排除、失败恢复、界面语言及指标缺口。

research_gaps.en: Shared-login or separate-login collaboration guidance is older; current team permission, audit and approval capabilities were not established.
research_gaps.zh: 共享／独立登录协作指南较旧，未确定现行团队权限、审计及审批能力。

research_gaps.en: API contract, self-hosting, source-code licence, retry/idempotency guarantees, precise recurring edit semantics and full regional availability remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: API 契约、自托管、源码许可、重试／幂等保证、准确重复编辑语义及全部地区可用性未知。

research_gaps.en: No app installation, account connection, AI generation, publishing or independent business-outcome measurement was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未安装应用、连接账户、生成 AI、发布或独立测量业务效果。
